harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created the appworker account on node1 and configured its login sessions with an 8,192 open-file limit and a 256-process limit via /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf. Verified enforcement through an actual pam_limits login shell both before and after a full node reboot, confirming persistence.
actions_performed: Wrote /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf with soft/hard nofile=8192 and soft/hard nproc=256
Verified limits via 'sudo -i -u appworker' login shell (ulimit -n / ulimit -u)
Captured healthy baseline: boot_id, uptime, user existence, limits config, enforced ulimits
Issued native reboot (shutdown -r now) on node1 with acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec was reachable again
Confirmed changed boot_id (83a0a80f... -> 1638d34f...) proving an actual restart occurred
Re-verified appworker account, limits config file, and enforced ulimits (8192/256) after restart

evidence.summary: id/getent passwd show appworker (uid 1000) exists with home /home/appworker and shell /bin/bash

evidence.requirement: Login sessions limited to 8192 open files and 256 processes
evidence.summary: /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf sets soft/hard nofile=8192 and soft/hard nproc=256; a real pam_limits login shell (sudo -i -u appworker) reports ulimit -n=8192 and ulimit -u=256, both before and after the node restart
Captured boot_id 83a0a80f-773c-4f3e-9137-1e7aa887b07a plus appworker account/limits state prior to reboot
shutdown -r now dispatched via nohup/background, command acknowledged and stream closed as node went down for reboot

evidence.requirement: Node1 changed boot identity proving restart
evidence.summary: Node unreachable during reboot (connection timeouts), then came back with boot_id 1638d34f-88f6-4af9-9fc3-0d3f4341712a, different from the pre-restart boot_id, proving an actual reboot occurred

evidence.requirement: Node1 post-restart recovery of appworker account and limits
evidence.summary: Post-restart: appworker account intact, limits.d config file intact, and login shell ulimits confirm 8192 open files / 256 processes still enforced
